mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO PROCUREMENT_QUOTE_CHECK_ITEM ( ID, CHECK_ID, BATCH_ID, ROW_NUMBER, SUPPLIER_NAME, QUOTE_AMOUNT, PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION, OVER_BUDGET, OVER_BUDGET_AMOUNT, OVER_BUDGET_RATIO, DEVIATION_RATIO, IS_SUSPICIOUS, SUSPICIOUS_REASON, CREATED_TIME ) VALUES
( #{row.id}, #{row.checkId}, #{row.batchId}, #{row.rowNumber}, #{row.supplierName}, #{row.quoteAmount}, #{row.productDescription}, #{row.overBudget}, #{row.overBudgetAmount}, #{row.overBudgetRatio}, #{row.deviationRatio}, #{row.suspicious}, #{row.suspiciousReason}, #{row.createdTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT ID, BATCH_ID, BUDGET_AMOUNT, AVERAGE_QUOTE, STANDARD_DEVIATION, COEFFICIENT_OF_VARIATION, HIGHLY_CONCENTRATED, RISK_LEVEL, CREATED_TIME FROM ( SELECT ID, BATCH_ID, BUDGET_AMOUNT, AVERAGE_QUOTE, STANDARD_DEVIATION, COEFFICIENT_OF_VARIATION, HIGHLY_CONCENTRATED, RISK_LEVEL, CREATED_TIME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CREATED_TIME DESC, ID DESC) AS RN FROM PROCUREMENT_QUOTE_CHECK WHERE BATCH_ID = #{batchId} ) CHECK_DATA WHERE RN = 1

SELECT ID, CHECK_ID, BATCH_ID, ROW_NUMBER, SUPPLIER_NAME, QUOTE_AMOUNT, PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION, OVER_BUDGET, OVER_BUDGET_AMOUNT, OVER_BUDGET_RATIO, DEVIATION_RATIO, IS_SUSPICIOUS, SUSPICIOUS_REASON, CREATED_TIME FROM PROCUREMENT_QUOTE_CHECK_ITEM WHERE CHECK_ID = #{checkId} ORDER BY ROW_NUMBER
SELECT REPORT_JSON FROM PROCUREMENT_QUOTE_COMPARISON WHERE CHECK_ID = #{id}

SELECT L.BATCH_ID AS PROJECT_ID, D.BUDGET_APPROVAL_ID AS PROJECT_CODE, D.PROCUREMENT_NAME AS PROJECT_NAME, I.SUPPLIER_NAME, I.QUOTE_AMOUNT, L.CREATED_TIME AS QUOTE_TIME FROM ( SELECT C.ID, C.BATCH_ID, C.CREATED_TIME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C.BATCH_ID ORDER BY C.CREATED_TIME DESC, C.ID DESC) AS RN FROM PROCUREMENT_QUOTE_CHECK C INNER JOIN PROCUREMENT_DEMAND D ON D.ID = C.BATCH_ID WHERE D.SUBJECT_CODE = #{subjectCode} AND D.PROCUREMENT_METHOD IS NOT NULL AND D.PROCUREMENT_METHOD <> '公开招标' AND C.CREATED_TIME >= #{fiscalYearStart} AND C.CREATED_TIME < #{fiscalYearEnd} ) L INNER JOIN PROCUREMENT_QUOTE_CHECK_ITEM I ON I.CHECK_ID = L.ID INNER JOIN PROCUREMENT_DEMAND D ON D.ID = L.BATCH_ID WHERE L.RN = 1 ORDER BY I.SUPPLIER_NAME, L.CREATED_TIME, L.BATCH_ID, I.ROW_NUMBER
